description: Independent researchers estimated the cost of Twelve Together in Chula Vista, California, at \"$307 a student per month of program participation\" (in 2006 dollars).
title: Estimated cost of Twelve Together implementation

description: A normed corpus of 27 one-paragraph passages (nine narrative, nine factual, nine conceptual) with scores on five dimensions: familiarity (linkage), imagery, interest, reading ease, and word frequency.
title: Twenty-seven one-paragraph passages scaled for linkage, imagery, interest, reading ease, and word frequency

description: The study's data source is a comprehensive administrative record from a medium-sized highly selective university.
title: Administrative dataset of all applicant contacts with one selective university's admissions office across two admission cycles

description: The study draws on assessment data from a very large national sample of kindergarten students to estimate trends in math and reading skills at school entry between 2010 and 2017.
title: National dataset of over 2 million kindergarten students used to estimate 2010-2017 school-entry skill trends

description: The studied SCMD environment was a Web-based chat system with a top pane displaying messages chronologically with ordinal numbers and authors' names, and a bottom pane for composing messages.
title: Text-based synchronous chat with two-pane chronological display in a graduate seminar
